entry.title: Red Bridge, Saint Petersburg
entry.note: Original photo-led iron crossing on the exact mapped skew. Extended stone abutments and bank levels are approximate; adjacent quays and buildings remain independent.

groundCutout.basis: Bounded34.9m by19.5m visualization cut within the modeled support footprint: coarse standard terrain otherwise rises through the eastern deck and rail. Source DEM and water stay unchanged; obstructing displayed ground/shore faces are removed while the bridge is resident.

basis: Exact-QID OSM relation 5552481 / Q2994703 supplies the retained skewed 25.999m by 16.915m central footprint; standard PMTiles supplies the two named road directions and sidewalks. Anchor [30.3153079,59.9329842], heading -0.936225120965: +X southeast along Gorokhovaya Street, -X northwest, +Z southwest along the Moika. A 0.147 plan shear follows the mapped edges. The nominal 33.6m longitudinal extent includes approximate abutments; small supported bank aprons extend beyond it. A 17.030528m source datum fits the complete native fixture's 17.555132m water surface. All 27 actual mapped road/footway width probes have both road and model support, within 0.047155m at all four levels. These are renderer-to-model join differences, not surveyed geographic accuracy.
limitations: Photo-based iron sections, arch rise, granite blocks and lamp heights are approximate; no as-built survey is claimed.

The retained 25.999m by16.915m map polygon describes the central crossing. The nominal33.6m reference length is interpreted along the sheared longitudinal coordinate including abutments; it is not substituted for the mapped clear deck.
Floral ironwork is a regularized open circle-and-rosette pattern. Rivet counts, internal ribs and lamp fittings are representative rather than surveyed.

The17.030528m source datum follows the17.555132m water surface in the complete retained native fixture. Water/ground levels depend on semantic tile context; this is a visualization datum rather than a survey. Coarse quays and neighboring architecture are outside this asset.
Skyline merges subpixel rail ornament into mean-color bands; district simplifies the pattern and hanging lanterns.

Thin bank paving and rectangular support wings overlap the generalized map lane/footway widths. A bounded34.9m by19.5m terrain cut follows those supports; native ground restores on unload. Surrounding quays retain the coarse standard terrain.

The surrounding procedural buildings, coarse quays, automatic retaining faces, power lines and approach terrain are context, not a reconstruction of historic Saint Petersburg. Some road-facing native cameras are obstructed by those coarse faces; whole-crossing and canal views show the bridge fit.
The final 4.8cm maximum paving join difference includes generalized skewed footway edges. The whole fixture is a standard-terrain approximation; no exact curb, foundation or river-stage claim.

metadataReconciliation.method: Removed unreachable branches for three unrelated model IDs from the Red Bridge-only generator. The generator --check passed after cleanup. Source/master/four LODs, spec and scene bytes, shared material graphs, all cameras and all 62 inspected frame bytes remain unchanged. Existing images keep their provenance; no new rendering is claimed.
